generated_prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a professional adult English coursebook occupation vocabulary sheet. Create ONE wide landscape contact sheet with TEN distinct full-body editorial ink-and-gouache illustrations, arranged in exactly TWO ROWS OF FIVE EQUAL CELLS. Real transparent alpha background across the sheet, each figure separated with generous empty gutters, no cell frames, no words, no letters, no numerals, no logos. Deliberately illustrated, never photorealistic or 3D; confident slightly irregular black ink contours, sophisticated limited flat colors with subtle paper/grain texture within colored areas, natural ordinary adult body proportions, expressive simple faces, humane and contemporary, like a talented magazine illustrator. Adults vary in ethnicity and age; avoid stereotyped gender assignments. Each cell's person, head, hands and feet fully visible, not clipped. Top row left to right: (1) female teacher holding a book with a simple small blank chalkboard on a stand; (2) adult male student with a backpack and notebook; (3) male chef in a white chef jacket/apron holding a mixing bowl; (4) female doctor with a stethoscope and clipboard; (5) male office worker seated at a compact laptop desk. Bottom row left to right: (6) male receptionist behind a low hotel reception desk with a small service bell, no text; (7) female salesclerk beside a small clothes rail holding a shopping bag; (8) male taxi driver standing beside the front quarter of a yellow taxi, no signage; (9) female restaurant server holding a tray with cups; (10) female farmer in practical work clothes holding a basket of vegetables with a small plant. Every occupation must be identifiable by action and tools, not uniform alone. Keep approximately equal visible figure heights; mostly standing figures, compact desk/vehicle props. Colors: charcoal, brick red, ochre, deep teal, natural cream within painted objects. White/transparent open paper around each drawing. No decorative blobs, no gradients, no shadows across transparent canvas, no glossy skin, no cute childish cartoon style. The sheet will be shown as a clean 5-by-2 teaching grid and cropped to individual native cells with CSS; accurate equal grid placement is essential.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a single elegant editorial ink-and-gouache illustration for an adult beginner English coursebook, portrait format roughly3:4. A FICTIONAL Ecuadorian family of four at their small ordinary neighborhood restaurant, with recognizably hand-drawn slightly irregular black ink contours, muted but confident brick red/ochre/forest/cream flat gouache, subtle paper grain, natural humane proportions. Deliberately an authored illustration, never photographic, no 3D plastic rendering, no generic cute children's cartoon. Father about42, short dark wavy hair, blue apron over white T-shirt, stands left holding an empty plate; mother about40, dark shoulder-length hair, coral blouse, stands center-right with a small order notebook; teenage son about15 in sage-green T-shirt sits front-left; daughter about12 in mustard-yellow T-shirt sits front-right. Four whole distinct faces looking naturally toward each other, no extra people. They smile gently in a candid interaction around a small wooden restaurant table with a water bottle, blue notebook, plain keys and a black phone separated and visible on the tabletop. Background is a simple warm restaurant counter, open window and a plant, not a large blank color panel. Compose the two parents clearly above the two children so family roles can be labeled in live HTML below. Keep all people unobstructed and readable, full heads and hands, no cropped eyes/hair. Do not add any writing or generated letters: no restaurant sign, names, menu letters, text on clothes, numbers, speech bubbles, logos or watermarks. Rich illustration texture and ordinary local detail without poverty stereotypes. Leave modest breathing room. A cohesive fictional source drawing, not an imitation of any named illustrator and not a copied scene.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE wide landscape triptych comic, exactly THREE EQUAL vertical panels left-to-right, for an adult A1 English exercise matching times to a morning routine. Deliberate professional pen-and-gouache illustration with lightly irregular black contours, clear ordinary anatomy, subtle paper grain and warm restrained colors; not photographic, not 3D, not childish clip art, no generic vector blobs. SAME fictional adult woman in all three panels: medium brown skin, short curly black hair, rust-red long-sleeve top, navy trousers. Exact actions LEFT TO RIGHT must be: PANEL A she leaves her apartment through the front door holding a navy work bag, wearing her coat open, whole head and visible feet; PANEL B earlier at her small kitchen table she eats breakfast from a bowl with a spoon, a plate of toast nearby and an UNTOUCHED FULL glass of water placed on the table; PANEL C same kitchen and same woman AFTER breakfast, she lifts the water glass to her lips, empty breakfast bowl/plate with crumbs still plainly visible in front of her. Keep the order deliberately nonchronological A leave / B breakfast / C drink water. Each panel has enough contextual room and all faces, hands, drinking glass and breakfast evidence fully within its own cell. Small even off-white gutters between the panels, no outside frame. Native empty paper in upper-left corner of each panel for live A/B/C labels, do NOT generate those labels. Absolutely no words, captions, times, numerals, clocks, speech balloons, watermarks or brands anywhere. Clear humane expressions, consistent hair/clothes/kitchen evidence across panels. Crisp print-ready narrative illustration. Preserve exactly three panels and three actions, no extra scenes or people.
